# Code in many languages

```kotlin
fun main() { println("hello") }
```

```java
class Hello { public static void main(String[] a) { System.out.println("hi"); } }
```

```python
def greet(name):
    return f"hello {name}"
```

```javascript
const add = (a, b) => a + b;
```

```typescript
const add = (a: number, b: number): number => a + b;
```

```json
{ "name": "bifolio", "pages": 2 }
```

```yaml
name: bifolio
pages: 2
```

```toml
name = "bifolio"
pages = 2
```

```bash
echo "hello" | tr a-z A-Z
```

```sql
SELECT id, title FROM documents WHERE pages > 2;
```

```html
<p class="x">hello</p>
```

```css
p { margin: 0 auto; }
```

```markdown
# A heading inside a fence
```

```c
int main(void) { return 0; }
```

```cpp
int main() { return 0; }
```

```go
func main() { println("hi") }
```

```rust
fn main() { println!("hi"); }
```

```swift
print("hi")
```

+ new line
